from pathlib import Path
p=Path('programs/task-66d06465.py')
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Translate every non-background cell down one row; cells falling off the bottom disappear.
    values = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    bg = max(set(values), key=values.count)
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[bg] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != bg:
                out[r + 1][c] = grid[r][c]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
# verify against demo and test behavior
